name: Hooked On Pokè
notes: All 3 photos were menus: sidewalk chalkboard (sides/starters, seaweed salads, desserts), a printed Poke Signature Bowls sheet (raw and baked bowls), and a digital sushi/sashimi/specialty rolls screen. Merged with no duplicates; skipped chalkboard add-on modifiers (wasabi/masago/avocado/dressing).
